svg.aria-label: Detection pipeline. Five log sources feed Wazuh: the Cisco network (ISR 4331 and Catalyst 3850s), OPNsense with Suricata (firewall logs and IDS alerts), the Windows domain (SWAGGER-DC-01, DC-02, FS-01 and CA-01), Proxmox and Docker, and UniFi. Wazuh, running in Docker on SWAGGER-NMS-01, decodes the logs, correlates them against its rules and responds, then forwards events to Splunk for search and dashboards. In the animation, a brute force attempt on SWAGGER-DC-01 raises a level 10 alert, active response blocks the source, and the alert is forwarded to Splunk.
svg.title: Detection pipeline
